Tree Plantation Drive – Saphale Service Project

Saphale, 22nd July 2026

As part of its commitment to environmental sustainability, the Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo successfully conducted a Tree Plantation Drive in the Rodkhad and Kanderpure villages of the Saphale region.

During the initiative, 60 saplings were planted to promote a greener, healthier, and more sustainable environment for the local community. The plantation drive reflected Rotary's dedication to environmental conservation while encouraging awareness about the importance of protecting nature for future generations.

The project was carried out with the active participation of Rtn. Sanjay, Rtn. Navin Mishra, Rtn. Alka, Rtn. Atul, and Rtn. Lopa, whose collective efforts exemplified Rotary's spirit of Service Above Self.

Project Highlights
60 Saplings Planted
Promoted environmental sustainability and community awareness
Contributed towards creating a greener future for the Saphale region

Service Above Self
